Framing a conversation

You will learn

What a clocked conversation changes, and how the SPI spec states its modes and rates.

A conversation needs rules about when a word starts and ends, or the far side samples noise. The clocked answer is SPI, and the spec of this lesson, SPI_Master, states its ground: CLK_FREQ at 50,000,000, SPI_CPOL and SPI_CPHA at 0, a maximum data width of 32 bits. The recording runs t27c check on it: 0 errors, 0 warnings. The three buses this module opens -- UART, SPI, APB -- are the three answers the course takes apart, one per module.

Try it

In the recording, find the error and warning counts; then in the spec frame find CLK_FREQ, CPOL and CPHA, and say which mode the spec configures.
